---
title: "Schedule"
description: "The schedule is intended for when following a live workshop. For materials, see **Contents**"
date: ""
toc: false
number-sections: false
sidebar: false
toastui:
  schedule:
    defaultView: week
    file: "schedule.tsv"
    file-sep: "\t"
    date: "2026-10-05"
    useDetailPopup: true
    isReadOnly: true
    height: 980px
    timegridHeight: 900px
    eventDetailItems:
      - attendees
    popupDetailItems:
      - attendees
      - calendar
    week:
      workweek: true
      taskView: false
      eventView: ['time']
      showNowIndicator: true
    autoHourRange: true
    timezone:
      zones:
        - timezoneName: Europe/Stockholm
    calendars:
      - id: "talk"
        name: "Talk"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#A7D4CA"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#A7D4CA"
        borderColor: "#6AAA99"
      - id: "lab"
        name: "Lab"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#D5EEE8"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#D5EEE8"
        borderColor: "#9BCDBF"
      - id: "free"
        name: "Free"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#F5D9BD"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#F5D9BD"
        borderColor: "#DDAF83"
      - id: "extra"
        name: "Extra"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#D6E5F3"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#D6E5F3"
        borderColor: "#9DBBD8"
format: html
---

<!-- Remember to set first day of schedule and file path in the YAML above -->
{{< toastui schedule >}}
